nav.tagline: Software developer and founder of TradeCatch.

hero.paragraph: I build web applications, backend systems and business tools. Right now, most of my time goes into TradeCatch, my business for contractors in Québec.

about.title: About
about.p1: I’m a computer science student at Collège de Bois-de-Boulogne and the founder of TradeCatch. I work across the product: API design, databases, the interface and deployment.
about.p2: TradeCatch is my current focus. Alongside it, I’ve built research tools, security systems and games, both independently and as part of a team.
about.p3: Outside programming, I train in wrestling, judo and weightlifting, follow financial markets, and spend my summers organizing activities for seniors at a community centre in Montréal.

workItems.body: Building and running a bilingual call recovery and follow-up service for contractors in Québec. Product development, customer workflows, setup and monitoring.
Built Dossier and SentinelOps, with work on backend architecture, REST APIs, authentication, databases and cloud deployment.
Selling shoes in store, welcoming customers, answering their questions and helping them find the right pair.
Led recreational and social activities for seniors over two summers.
Cleared and reset tables, supported the serving team through peak service.

tradecatch.title: TradeCatch
tradecatch.tagline: Call handling and follow-up for contractors.
tradecatch.description: I’m building and running TradeCatch for contractors in Québec. It handles missed calls, collects job details and follows up on estimates in French and English.
tradecatch.ownership: I handle the product, development, setup and monitoring.
tradecatch.screenshotAlt: The live TradeCatch homepage, showing its call recovery service

steps.title: Missed call
steps.body: When a contractor can’t answer, TradeCatch starts the follow-up with a text in the caller’s language.

steps.title: Job details
steps.body: The workflow collects the service needed, contact details and urgency, then alerts the contractor.

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.body: Estimate reminders continue until the customer replies, opts out or the contractor takes over.
